description: Use this when the couple asks about their own store credit. The signed-in couple's own Zola store credit: the total, the part that expires, and each credit with its source and end date, the first to expire first. Store credit pays for items in the Zola shop. For cash gifts, use zola_get_my_cash_gifts_and_transfers. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read). Do not use for how store credit works on Zola in general: use zola_search_help_articles.
name: zola_get_my_credits

outputSchema.description: The Zola store credit of the signed-in user

credits.description: The credit that expires first comes first

expires_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Null when it does not expire

exists.description: Always true: the credits belong to the user

expiring_total_cents.description: The part of the total that has an end date

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

title: Get My Zola Store Credit
